# Disposable PPK interoperability fixtures

These four files contain the same **publicly known, test-only Ed25519 private
key**. Never use them for authentication or trust them in any real system.
The encrypted files have passphrase `test-only-passphrase`.

They were generated by PuTTYgen (PuTTY source mirror commit
`503d6139d5e1a7c727343e7c06c39778f18dfb25`) in v2 and v3, both unencrypted
and encrypted. The v3 encrypted file uses Argon2id with deliberately low
parameters for fast tests; real keys should use much stronger parameters.
